description: Update the SQLite connection handling to support opening named in-memory databases using SQLite URI syntax. Currently, the system only supports basic in-memory connections, but we need to extend this to allow for named in-memory databases that can be shared between connections.
functional_requirements: Modify the database connection logic to parse and handle SQLite URI format for in-memory databases
Support the 'file::memory:' URI pattern with optional name parameters (e.g., 'file::memory:?cache=shared&name=mydb')
Ensure thread-safe connection handling maintains proper isolation between different named in-memory databases
Update connection tests to verify that named in-memory databases work correctly and can be shared between connections when specified
